get_example_data: get example model, input tensor, and category ID data from the torchray benchmark module
get_module: get a specific submodule from a PyTorch model by its dotted path string
Probe: create a Probe on a model layer to capture its output tensor during forward pass
gradient_to_grad_cam_saliency: convert captured gradient data into a Grad-CAM saliency map from a probe
plot_example: plot an input image alongside its Grad-CAM saliency map with a title and category ID
